items.issue: The initially proposed parent mikey-approach-009 is not the same recording: its reviewed participants, red-armband third party, dialogue and scene sequence differ from this Short.
affected_evidence: formal mikey-approach-009 transcript and visual review
items.disposition: Treat as a distinct research case unless an exact parent is later established; generic visual setting and clothing similarity cannot support duplicate status.

items.issue: The title frames the clip as handling rejection, while the first woman's exact reply is not reliably transcribed; she visibly continues away and the man turns to a different group.
items.disposition: Do not infer permission to persist after refusal. Treat clear refusal or continued departure as a stop signal and keep the switch to another interaction as a case observation only.

items.issue: ASR contains a WeChat request and frames show phone handling, but no legible screen or continuous save sequence proves a voluntary contact exchange.
items.disposition: Do not claim contact success, attraction or later meeting; require a clear voluntary response and preserve an easy exit.

items.issue: Identifiable public participants and bystanders are filmed; consent to recording and publication is not shown.
items.disposition: Do not package identifiable imagery or infer publication permission without independent privacy and authorization review.

items.issue: The man self-identifies as Mike, but the Short does not independently authenticate him as Mikey; several participant turns and the role or speech of the person with a cart are unclear.
items.disposition: Keep speaker attribution provisional, do not assign unclear turns to Mikey, and do not describe the third party as security or an authority without evidence.

items.issue: The man comments that the woman is cute and 'small', while age and adulthood are never established.
items.disposition: Do not infer age from appearance or use the comment as guidance; adulthood must be clearly established before any romantic pursuit.

items.issue: Several automatic segments are corrupted or merge speaker turns, including location, WeChat and local-origin phrases.
items.disposition: Do not quote these segments verbatim without original-audio verification; use only the bounded event-level summary.
